en.title: Who Needs to File an Income Tax Return?
en.directAnswer: Whether you must file a return depends on the current Income Tax Act and tax-year rules. It is not based only on whether tax is payable. Some people must file because of income, status, transactions or other legal triggers. This page must be updated every tax year.

atAGlance.whoFor: A citizen wants to know whether they have a return duty.

en.lawMeaning:
Separate three questions: Do I need a TIN? Do I need to file a return? Do I owe tax? They are not always the same.

This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
steps: Check any transaction/status that requires proof of return.
File even if tax is zero when filing is still legally required.
evidence: Relevant official notices, receipts, and correspondence
en.simpleExample: A person owes no final tax but needs proof of return for a legally specified transaction. “No tax” does not automatically mean “no return.”
en.specialistTrigger: Complex status; company/director links; foreign income; missed years; notice from NBR.
